title: Mission 10: The Census
story: Headquarters wants numbers by noon: how big is everything the department produced this quarter? Nobody counts by hand here. wc is the census-taker - lines, words, bytes - and it never miscounts. Your job is asking it the right question.

badge.name: The Census: Counted
badge.desc: Mastered wc by measuring a quarter's worth of files in lines, words and bytes.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING10.txt in your department directory. How many LINES is census/minutes.txt? Just the number (no filename) to census/minutes_lines.txt - wc prints the filename when you pass one, but reading from a pipe or redirect leaves the number alone.

checks.fail: minutes_lines.txt must contain just the line count of minutes.txt (feed wc from stdin so no filename tags along).

tasks.brief: Legal bills by the WORD. Count the words in census/contract.txt - just the number - to census/contract_words.txt.

checks.fail: contract_words.txt must contain just the word count of contract.txt.

tasks.brief: The archive team charges per BYTE. Count the bytes in census/export.bin - just the number - to census/export_bytes.txt.

checks.fail: export_bytes.txt must contain just the byte count of export.bin.

tasks.brief: The printer truncates anything past its width. What is the LENGTH of the longest line in census/banner.txt? Just the number to census/banner_width.txt (wc has a max-line-length option).

checks.fail: banner_width.txt must contain the longest line's length (wc's max-line-length option).

tasks.brief: How many ERROR lines does census/build.log contain? Mission 08 finds them; wc counts them. Pipe the two together and put just the number in census/errorcount.txt. (Yes, grep -c exists - but the pipe pattern works with ANY producer, which is why HQ standardized on it.)

checks.fail: errorcount.txt must contain the number of ERROR lines in build.log (search piped into a line count).

tasks.brief: The quarterly total: run one wc over ALL THREE reports (census/report_q1.txt report_q2.txt report_q3.txt) and save the FULL output - per-file lines/words/bytes AND the total row, exactly as wc prints it - to census/quarter_totals.txt.

checks.fail: quarter_totals.txt must be wc's full multi-file output including the total row (one command, three filenames, run from census/).
The census sources were modified. A census counts; it never edits.

tasks.brief: BONUS: HQ claims census/blank.txt is truly empty. Prove it: its byte count to census/blank_proof.txt. Zero is the only acceptable number.

checks.fail: blank_proof.txt must contain exactly 0 (the byte count of an empty file).
